name: Cat-Cow Flow
description: A gentle, repetitive flow coordinating spinal arching and rounding with inhalation and exhalation.
benefits: Warms up and mobilizes the entire spine

steps.instruction: Start on hands and knees with a flat, neutral tabletop spine.
steps.voice_prompt: Start on your hands and knees with your spine flat, hands under shoulders, and knees under hips.

steps.instruction: Cat Pose: Exhale and round your spine up toward the ceiling.
steps.voice_prompt: Exhale, pull your belly in, round your spine up towards the ceiling, and tuck your chin.

steps.instruction: Hold Cat Pose, breathing into your shoulders.
steps.voice_prompt: Hold the cat stretch. Feel the space opening up between your shoulder blades.

steps.instruction: Cow Pose: Inhale, drop your belly down, and lift your chest.
steps.voice_prompt: Inhale, drop your navel toward the floor, lift your chest, and look up gently.

steps.instruction: Return to a flat, neutral tabletop position.
steps.voice_prompt: Slowly release and return your spine to a flat tabletop position.
